[[Grook Plugalug]] is a [[Jungle Troll]] [[boss]].  As with other Jungle Trolls, it has access to the [[ranger]] skill [[Troll Unguent]].

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}}
** {{NPC location|The Wilds}} (random spawn, see notes)

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Gash}}
* {{skill icon|Seeking Blade}}
* {{skill icon|Sever Artery}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Jungle Troll Tusk]]

== Notes ==
* In The Wilds mission, Grook Plugalug spawns randomly at one of four points.  It shares those spawn points with [[Tree of Vitality]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], [[Wydd Kindlerun]], and [[Grech Trundle]].  As such, there is a 20% chance that this boss may not spawn.
